title: Twice-Told Critiques: Claim-Level Homogenization of Peer Review in the LLM Era
abstract: arXiv:2611.26286v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Peer review relies on several readers finding different problems. We measure critique overlap in conference and journal reviews. At ICLR, measured overlap rose from 12.0% in 2026 to 21.3% in 2027, in reviews from the same stage of the review process, with year-on-year rises at NeurIPS, ICML and the F1000 and PLOS journals. A third ICLR review of a paper added 5.46 new problems to the other two in 2027, against 6.12 in 2026. We apply MELD, a detector of LLM-generated text, to all reviews. Within a paper, two reviews that MELD flags overlap more than two unflagged reviews: by 3.0 points at ICLR in 2024-2025, by 4.5 points in 2026-2027, and by 5.4 points across five journal sources. These results provide evidence that LLM-flagged reviews of one paper are less distinct from each other than unflagged reviews, and suggest that the diversity of critiques among reviews of a single paper is falling.

translated_title: 重复讲述的批评：LLM时代同行评审在声明层面的同质化
translated_abstract: 同行评审依赖于多位读者发现不同的问题。我们测量了会议和期刊评审中的批评重叠度。在ICLR，同一评审阶段评审中的重叠度从2026年的12.0%上升到2027年的21.3%，NeurIPS、ICML以及F1000和PLOS期刊也出现了逐年上升。2027年，一篇论文的第三份ICLR评审仅为其前两份评审新增了5.46个新问题，而2026年这一数字为6.12。我们对所有评审应用了MELD（一种LLM生成文本检测器）。在同一篇论文内，被MELD标记的两份评审比未被标记的两份评审重叠度更高：2024-2025年ICLR高出3.0个百分点，2026-2027年高出4.5个百分点，五个期刊来源合计高出5.4个百分点。这些结果提供了证据，表明被标记为LLM生成的评审彼此之间的差异性低于未被标记的评审，并暗示单篇论文各评审之间的批评多样性正在下降。
tldr: 通过测量会议和期刊评审中的声明级重叠度，研究发现LLM时代同行评审的批评意见日益同质化——ICLR评审重叠率从2026年的12.0%升至2027年的21.3%，且被检测为LLM生成的评审比人工评审重叠度更高，表明单篇论文评审的批评多样性正在下降。
en_tdlr: Measuring claim-level overlap in conference and journal peer reviews reveals growing homogenization in the LLM era—ICLR review overlap rose from 12.0% in 2026 to 21.3% in 2027, and reviews flagged as LLM-generated overlap more than unflagged ones, suggesting that critique diversity among reviews of a single paper is declining.
